Fasting is the metabolic state achieved after complete digestion and absorption of a meal. 

Fasting of periods of 6 hours is normal within daily life and thus well tolerated. 24hour fasts are less common and associated with more significant physiological effects.

+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                         | **6hr Fast **                                                                           | **24hr Fast **                                                                                                                                    |
+=========================================+=========================================================================================+===================================================================================================================================================+
| **Energy Sources **                     | As Blood glucose levels fall energy provided by glycogenolysis in the liver and muscle. | With depletion of glycogen stores every requirements increasing met by gluconeogenesis from substrates including free fatty acids and proteolysis |
|                                         |                                                                                         |                                                                                                                                                   |
|                                         | Total stores are \~ 100g in liver and 400g in muscle → 12-24hrs supply                  |                                                                                                                                                   |
+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Fluid/Renal**                         | Insensible and urine production → minimal fluid Loss (1% TBW)                           | Depletion of body water relative hypovolaemia and ↑osmolality                                                                                     |
|                                         |                                                                                         |                                                                                                                                                   |
|                                         | ↑slight osmolality/dec fluid levels → slight ↑ADH levels                                | ↑ADH → Concentrated urine and thirst                                                                                                              |
|                                         |                                                                                         |                                                                                                                                                   |
|                                         | To form more concentrated urine                                                         | RAAS Pathway active                                                                                                                               |
+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Hormonal Changes**                    | ↓Insulin Levels                                                                         | Insulin release inhibited                                                                                                                         |
|                                         |                                                                                         |                                                                                                                                                   |
|                                         | ↑Glucagon Release                                                                       |                                                                                                                                                   |
|                                         |                                                                                         |                                                                                                                                                   |
|                                         | ↑Adrenaline                                                                             |                                                                                                                                                   |
|                                         |                                                                                         |                                                                                                                                                   |
|                                         | ↑Cortisol                                                                               |                                                                                                                                                   |
+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Adipose tissue and Skeletal Muscle ** | Decrease Glucose uptake due to ↓Insulin→ GLUT 4 activity                                | ↑Proteolysis from muscle                                                                                                                          |
|                                         |                                                                                         |                                                                                                                                                   |
|                                         | Start of ↑ lipolysis from adipose tissue                                                | Adipose tissue →↑FFA and glycerol release → B oxidation for energy production                                                                     |
|                                         |                                                                                         |                                                                                                                                                   |
|                                         |                                                                                         | ↑Ketone body production                                                                                                                           |
+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Liver **                              | ↑Glycogenolysis →↑Glucose Levels                                                        | Gluconeogenesis efficiency via upregulation of enzymes:                                                                                           |
|                                         |                                                                                         |                                                                                                                                                   |
|                                         |                                                                                         | - Cori cycle: lactate & pyruvate                                                                                                                  |
|                                         |                                                                                         | - Muscle: " Proteolysis ! "alanine & other amino acids                                                                                            |
|                                         |                                                                                         | - Adipose tissue: glycerol                                                                                                                        |
+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
